data.one_liner: Full-screen or embedded barcode and QR code scanner for Flutter built on mobile_scanner
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete barcode and QR code scanner UI for Android, iOS, macOS, and the web. Includes built-in controls like torches, zoom sliders, permissions handling, result rendering sheets, and gallery scanning.
use_when: You need a drop-in barcode or QR code scanner with a fully styled UI out-of-the-box.
You want to scan barcodes from the camera or from device images with minimal setup.
avoid_when: You are building a custom low-level computer vision pipeline without any pre-built UI.
You target platforms like Windows or Linux where camera scanning is unsupported out of the box.
strengths: Includes ready-made UI components like reticles, result sheets, and permission recovery screens.
Supports multiple scan modes including single, continuous, and batch scanning.
Re-exports mobile_scanner and covers multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Relies on underlying platform capabilities which differ per platform (e.g., no torch or focus controls on web or macOS).
Requires manual native permission configuration for iOS and macOS.
data.setup_notes: Add NSCameraUsageDescription (and optionally NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription) to iOS Info.plist, and camera entitlements on macOS. Android and web work out of the box.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want raw camera widgets and low-level control without the pre-built scanner UI and result sheets provided by this package.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer direct integration with Google ML Kit's barcode scanning APIs for custom image stream processing.
